Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial photograph for an understated premium real estate website promotional card about home insurance.
Subject: two real contemporary brushed-nickel house keys on a small simple brushed-steel key ring placed on a pale warm limestone side table. Behind the keys a closed slim warm ivory document folder with no visible markings, partly out of focus. Subtle softly blurred edge of a neutral sofa and a window in a bright quiet contemporary apartment. The keys are a secondary elegant still-life in the lower central third, generous peaceful living space around them.
Style: high-end interior editorial photography, tactile and believable real materials, extremely restrained composition, subtle natural imperfections, no stock-photo business handshake, no marketing symbols.
Composition: landscape 4:3, close-to-medium view at low angle, clear focal point toward the center, all important objects within central 65% so it can crop to square. No wide angle distortion.
Lighting: soft diffused window daylight, quiet gentle shadow, warm ivory and greige with a tiny reflected muted blue note, natural tonal depth. Premium architectural magazine quality.
Constraints: no text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no hands, no house shaped key ring, no miniature house, no padlock, no shield, no cash, no coins, no dramatic vignette.
